description: This file provides an immutable implementation of the RetrieveThingsLiveCommand interface, encapsulating logic for retrieving specific 'things' by their IDs and namespace in a live command context.

classes.name: RetrieveThingsLiveCommandImpl
classes.description: An immutable class implementing the RetrieveThingsLiveCommand interface, representing a live command to retrieve specific things with optional namespace filtering.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of RetrieveThingsLiveCommandImpl from a given Command object, casting it to RetrieveThings.

methods.name: getThingEntityIds
methods.description: Returns the list of ThingId objects representing the targeted things.

methods.name: getNamespace
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the namespace string if present.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new command with the specified DittoHeaders, preserving other fields.

methods.name: answer
methods.description: Returns a builder for constructing responses to this command.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object, including class name and namespace.
